<DOCSTRING>
Tests the max age functionality of the serializer.

Args:
    serializer (object): The serializer object used for signing and verifying values.
    value (any): The value to be signed and tested.
    ts (datetime): The timestamp when the value was signed.
    freeze (object): An object that can be used to simulate time passage.

Description:
This function tests whether the serializer correctly enforces the `max_age` parameter, which limits the lifetime of a signed value. The function first signs the value with the given serializer and then checks if the signed value can be successfully loaded within the specified `max_age` period. After 10 seconds, the function attempts to load the signed value again and asserts that it raises a `SignatureExpired` exception, ensuring that the `max_age` functionality works as intended.

Returns:
    void: This function asserts conditions and does not return a value directly.
</DOCSTRING>
